name: metrics_replay
description: Metrics of one replay tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned to its CPU

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 unless it is the only live tile pinned there

identity_balance_lamports.description: Identity account balance at the optimistically confirmed slot, or the finalized slot under Alpenglow

active_stake_lamports.description: Our active stake at the optimistically confirmed slot, or the finalized slot under Alpenglow

cluster_active_stake_lamports.description: Cluster active stake at the optimistically confirmed slot, or the finalized slot under Alpenglow

epoch_credits.description: gauge: current value, do not sum over time. Our vote account epoch credits at the optimistically confirmed slot, or the finalized slot under Alpenglow

is_vote_account_inadmissible.description: Whether our vote account's stake is not admitted: at the optimistically confirmed slot it fails the validator admission ticket filter (missing, below the V4 rent-exempt minimum, or not V4 with a BLS pubkey), or it passes but has not yet been admitted at an epoch boundary

last_rewarded_vote_slot.description: Latest slot for which our vote appears in a reward certificate, 0 if none observed (always 0 under Tower)

store_query_duration_nanos.description: Duration of ingesting one queried FEC set into the scheduler

store_fec_queried.description: FEC sets queried from the store

store_fec_query_missed.description: FEC set store queries that found no entry

store_fec_spilled.description: FEC payloads spilled from the store RAM cache to disk

store_fec_spilled_bytes.description: FEC payload bytes spilled from the store RAM cache to disk

store_fec_spill_read.description: Spilled FEC payloads read from disk

store_fec_spill_read_bytes.description: Spilled FEC payload bytes read from disk

store_fec_cache_used.description: FEC payload slots in use in the store RAM cache

store_fec_cache_capacity.description: FEC payload capacity of the store RAM cache

store_fec_cache_pinned.description: gauge: current value, do not sum over time. FEC payload views currently pinned against eviction

is_caught_up.description: Whether replay has caught up to the cluster tip; set once per run, never cleared

root_slot.description: Most recent consensus root, 0 if none

root_slot_distance.description: Slots between the current reset slot and our root

leader_slot.description: Slot at which we are currently leader, or 0 if none

next_leader_slot.description: Slot at which we are next leader, or 0 if none. If we are currently leader, this is the same as the current leader slot

reset_slot.description: Slot replay last reset to (Tower reset slot; under Alpenglow the newest replayed slot or parent-ready parent); can decrease

bank_capacity.description: Maximum number of banks we can have alive

reassembly_free.description: Free FEC sets in the reassembly queue

last_reassembly_dequeued_slot.description: Slot of the FEC set most recently dequeued from reassembly for replay, 0 if none

last_reassembly_dequeued_fec_index.description: FEC set index of the FEC set most recently dequeued from reassembly for replay; read with LastReassemblyDequeuedSlot

sched_active_bank_index.description: Bank pool index the replay scheduler is dispatching work for, ULONG_MAX if none

sched_last_dispatch_bank_index.description: Bank pool index the replay scheduler last dispatched work for, ULONG_MAX if none

sched_last_dispatch_time.description: Wall-clock time the replay scheduler last dispatched work, 0 if never

sched_staging_lane_used.description: Staging lanes currently occupied in the replay scheduler. Up to four staging lanes can be occupied at once

sched_staging_lane_peak.description: High watermark of staging lanes that were at one point occupied in the replay scheduler

sched_staging_lane_head_bank_index.description: Bank pool index at the head of each replay staging lane, ULONG_MAX if the lane is empty

sched_txn_pool_used.description: Transaction pool entries held by the replay scheduler, from parse until release

sched_txn_pool_capacity.description: Maximum transactions the replay scheduler can hold

sched_microblock_pool_used.description: Microblocks available to be scheduled in the replay scheduler

sched_microblock_pool_capacity.description: Maximum microblocks the replay scheduler can hold

sched_block_pool_used.description: Blocks alive in the replay scheduler

sched_block_pool_capacity.description: Maximum blocks the replay scheduler can track

sched_block_added.description: Blocks added to the replay scheduler, by staging state

dead.description: Added as the dead child of a dead block, never dispatched

sched_block_replayed.description: Blocks the replay scheduler considers fully replayed

sched_block_abandoned.description: Blocks the replay scheduler abandoned for any reason

sched_block_rejected.description: Blocks the replay scheduler found invalid while parsing or verifying PoH; also counted in SchedBlockAbandoned once drained; replay-tile verdicts not counted

sched_block_promoted.description: Blocks the replay scheduler promoted from unstaged to a staging lane

sched_block_demoted.description: Blocks the replay scheduler demoted from a staging lane to unstaged

sched_block_deactivated.description: Times the replay scheduler stopped dispatching a block, by reason

no_child.description: A block fully replayed and there was no child block available yet

no_work.description: A partially replayed block ran out of work to dispatch

abandoned.description: A block was abandoned, other than by minority fork pruning

minority_fork.description: A block was pruned for being on a minority fork (not also counted as Abandoned)

sched_lane_switched.description: Times the replay scheduler switched the lane it is dispatching from

sched_lane_promoted.description: Times the replay scheduler promoted one or more blocks onto a staging lane

sched_lane_demoted.description: Times the replay scheduler demoted one or more blocks from a staging lane

sched_fork_observed.description: Forks the replay scheduler has observed

sched_txn_lut_resolve_attempted.description: Transactions with address lookup tables the replay scheduler tried to resolve, by result

deferred.description: Address lookup table expansion failed on the published root while the parent block was still replaying, retried once it is done

sched_txn_parsed_abandoned.description: Transactions that were parsed but ended up being in abandoned blocks

sched_txn_executed_abandoned.description: Transactions that were executed but ended up being in abandoned blocks

sched_txn_done_abandoned.description: Transactions that were fully replayed but ended up being in abandoned blocks

sched_txn_in_flight_integral_nanos.description: Integral of in-flight transactions over time (transaction-nanoseconds); divide by SchedTxnBusyDurationNanos for the average in-flight count

sched_txn_busy_duration_nanos.description: Time the replay scheduler had at least one transaction in flight

sched_txn_idle_duration_nanos.description: Time the replay scheduler had no transaction in flight

sched_txn_parsed.description: Transactions the replay pipeline has parsed

sched_txn_executed.description: Transactions the replay pipeline has executed

sched_txn_signature_verified.description: Transactions the replay pipeline has sigverified

sched_txn_poh_mixed.description: Transactions the replay pipeline has performed PoH mixin on

sched_microblock_parsed.description: Microblocks the replay pipeline has parsed

sched_microblock_hashed.description: Microblocks the replay pipeline has fully hashed

sched_ingested_bytes.description: Bytes the replay scheduler has ingested

sched_trailing_skipped_bytes.description: Trailing bytes of a block the replay scheduler ingested but did not parse

sched_dropped_bytes.description: Bytes the replay scheduler refused to ingest because the block was abandoned

sched_fec_ingested.description: FEC sets the replay scheduler has been given

bank_frozen.description: Banks frozen, including our own leader blocks

chain_txn_height.description: gauge: current value, do not sum over time. Transactions from genesis through the last replayed block, 0 if none; drops on a fork switch

fec_poll_skipped.description: Replay loop iterations that processed no FEC set, by reason

leader_freeze_wait.description: Waiting for PoH to end our leader block

fec_parent_missing_dropped.description: FEC sets dropped because replay could not resolve the block's parent (Alpenglow), which was dropped on a dead lineage, evicted with its tracking slot reused, or rooted past

root_advance_deferred.description: Times the storage root could not advance to the consensus root yet

progcache_class_used.description: Program cache value slots in use, by size class

progcache_class_capacity.description: Program cache value capacity, by size class

accdb_account_readonly_acquired.description: Readonly accounts acquired from the account database, by cache size class of the account's current data size

accdb_account_writable_acquired.description: Writable accounts acquired from the account database, by cache size class of the account's current data size

accdb_account_evicted.description: Accounts evicted from the account database cache to make space, by cache size class

accdb_account_new_committed.description: New account versions committed to the index, by destination cache size class

accdb_account_overwrite_committed.description: Account versions committed over an existing version of the same fork and generation, by destination cache size class

accdb_account_cache_missed.description: Accounts not found in the account database cache and read from disk, by cache size class

accdb_account_waited.description: Accounts that had to wait for another reader to finish loading them into the cache

accdb_batch_acquired.description: Batch acquire calls made by this tile

accdb_cache_reserve_retried.description: Spin retries while waiting to reserve cache lines for a transaction

accdb_disk_read_bytes.description: Bytes read from the account database file

accdb_disk_read.description: Reads from the account database file

accdb_disk_written_bytes.description: Bytes written to the account database file

accdb_disk_written.description: Writes to the account database file

accdb_copied_bytes.description: Account data bytes copied in memory between cache lines, staging buffers and callers; disk reads excluded

is_runtime_loaded.description: Whether the runtime has loaded a bank and can replay

sched_block_serialized.description: Blocks whose remaining transactions the replay scheduler serialized, by reason

poison_overflow.description: The block's loader v3 poison set overflowed

lut_unresolved.description: A loader v3 candidate wrote through an address lookup table that failed to resolve

sched_txn_serialized.description: Transactions the replay scheduler dispatched as serializing barriers, by reason

lut_unresolved.description: Its address lookup tables failed to resolve

poison_hit.description: It writes an account in the block's loader v3 poison set

block_serialized.description: An earlier transaction serialized the rest of the block
